zh-Hans.text:
刘备完成宿愿后,
心中有各种思念。
和强敌交手、民生事,
最深的思念,
桃园结义的誓言。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
劉備完成宿願後,
心中有各種思念。
和強敵交手、民生事,
最深的思念,
桃園結義的誓言。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

review_notes: Five-line continuation of the same historical-ending branch; preserves five LF-delimited lines and compresses the source list into the fixed width. 民生 is a compact Taiwan Traditional Chinese rendering of the source's concern for common people; 桃園／桃園結義 follows the term cross-check. E-specific custom glyph use is none in this target. Natural ending-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.

zh-Hans.text:
「真想再回桃园,
　和兄弟共饮一杯」
刘备想起桃园景象,
不禁露出笑容。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
「真想再回桃園,
　和兄弟共飲一杯」
劉備想起桃園景象,
不禁露出笑容。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

review_notes: Four-line dialogue and narration continuation; retains the quoted speech, ideographic indentation, three full stops and fixed four-line layout. 桃園／桃園結義 follows the Taiwan Traditional Chinese term cross-check; target uses no E-specific custom glyph.
